SANDBOX — NOT PART OF THE HUMAN STUDY

Don't trust our prepared example.
Try your own revision.

One engine. Your evidence. Enter two source states and the statements that depend on them. Run, inspect, reset, repeat.

Judge-provided sandbox data

These inputs are not independently source-verified. Calculations stay in this browser. Sandbox activity does not enroll a study participant or send Flagsmith exposures or conversions. This page has no study question.

THE EVIDENCE

What changed at the source?

Use plain decimal numbers. Keep the same units and measure basis across releases. The engine refuses incompatible comparisons.

THE WORDING

What does the article claim?

Put {value} once in each sentence. A difference means first observation minus second. Percent change means (first − second) ÷ second × 100. Historical claims remain attached to the original source.

DERIVED BY THE REVISION ENGINE

Here is what the revision changes.

Inspect complete factual payload


Advanced: import or export structured JSON
The same validated schema powers these fields and the built-in witnesses. Import replaces the form and clears its previous result; it does not run automatically. Files, websites and formulas are never fetched or executed.

sandbox-schema.html:
ProofPivotSANDBOXTry your own revision

SANDBOX — NOT PART OF THE HUMAN STUDY

Your evidence,
in a small schema.

Schema 1 accepts two source objects, original and revised, and 1–30 claim definitions. Each source contains 1–40 observations indexed by identifier. Values must be plain decimal strings, up to 100 characters. Identifiers begin with a letter and contain only letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, up to 80 characters. No expressions inside values, exponents, thousands separators, websites, scraping or inferred units.

Each observation needs value, unit and basis; label and period are optional. Units and bases must match across releases and within each binary calculation. Semantics are exact explicit strings: the engine does not convert currencies, scales, frequency or adjustment. Zero denominators are rejected, including in revised historical inputs. Display precision is an integer from 0 to 12, rounded half away from zero.

Supported operations: observation, difference and percent_change. Binary args are ordered: first minus second, or (first − second) ÷ second × 100. Historical claims keep the original value and supported source. A changed dependency with the same displayed result is precision_preserving; unchanged dependencies are unaffected. No mathematical or factual result is supplied by the input.

{
  "schema": 1,
  "witness": "Judge-provided sandbox data",
  "historical_replay": false,
  "original": {
    "id": "original", "label": "First source",
    "observations": {
      "revenue": {"label":"Revenue", "value":"100.01", "unit":"USD", "basis":"Nominal revenue", "period":"Q1"},
      "cost": {"label":"Cost", "value":"80", "unit":"USD", "basis":"Nominal revenue", "period":"Q1"}
    }
  },
  "revised": {
    "id": "revised", "label": "Updated source",
    "observations": {
      "revenue": {"label":"Revenue", "value":"100.02", "unit":"USD", "basis":"Nominal revenue", "period":"Q1"},
      "cost": {"label":"Cost", "value":"80", "unit":"USD", "basis":"Nominal revenue", "period":"Q1"}
    }
  },
  "claims": [{
    "id":"margin", "label":"Revenue less cost",
    "sentence":"Revenue less cost was {value} USD.",
    "precision":1, "temporality":"current",
    "expression":{"op":"difference", "args":[
      {"op":"observation", "ref":"revenue"},
      {"op":"observation", "ref":"cost"}
    ]}
  }]
}

The shared portable payload builder supports nesting to depth four. Form import supports direct observation or a binary calculation on two observations. Import normalizes source IDs to original/revised and provenance to judge-provided data; it preserves the entered values, claim IDs, wording, calculations, precision and timing. The form requires matching observation sets, labels, periods, units and bases across releases. A complete replacement clears the previous result. Inputs live only in page memory and disappear on reset or reload.

Both previews receive the same immutable factual payload, serialized with sorted object keys and SHA256. A mismatch fails closed with TRUTH_LOCK_MISMATCH. The sandbox never imports the provider or ledger, never assigns an experiment identity, and uses a browser policy that forbids network connections. Static assets are served before study configuration is read.

Engine output does not verify the truth of supplied values or measure descriptions. Every preview remains labelled Judge-provided sandbox data.
